footer.tagline: One platform for customer, partner, and employee training.

hero.subtitle: Train your staff, educate your customers, certify your partners, or sell courses to the public — from one account, on your own domain, with certificates and an AI tutor in every lesson.

roi.heading: Customers who learn the product, stay.
roi.subhead: What a ClassroomHub academy gives you on day one:

domain.label: A branded academy
domain.source: Custom domain, your logo and colours

records.label: Recorded and exportable
records.source: Scores, timing, and completion per learner

home.tutor_description: An AI teaching assistant that adapts to each student: answering questions in their own words, adjusting to their pace, and catching the ones that would otherwise land in your support inbox.
home.cta_header: Whatever you teach, teach it here.
home.cta_subtext: Launch a branded academy on your own domain in a few days.

ai_builds.heading_lead: AI that turns company knowledge into trainings that drive
ai_builds.subhead: Feed it your docs, policies, videos, and internal knowledge. AI drafts the structure, lessons, and quizzes. You review and approve every step before learners see it.
ai_builds.image_alt: Course builder — plan, approve, implement. Templates, in-editor chat, and MCP.

template.title: Pick a template
template.description: Product 101, onboarding, or expert track. Fill three fields, get a course draft.

chat.title: Chat with the builder
chat.description: The AI builder lives in the editor. It plans, drafts, and writes quizzes. You approve each step.

agent.title: Use your own agent
agent.description: Drive course authoring from Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode via MCP.

features.subhead: Your brand, your domain, your content. ClassroomHub bends to fit the academy you want to ship.

theme.title: Theme everything
theme.description: Pick a theme color or drop in your own hex. Every page picks it up.

domain.title: Your domain
domain.description: Map a CNAME, click verify. SSL is handled. No ClassroomHub branding on the page.

embed.title: Embed anywhere
embed.description: One script tag. Drop courses into your help center, in-product, or marketing site.

stack.title: Wire it into your stack
stack.description: A typed REST API, signed webhooks, and an MCP server. Provision learners from the systems you already run.

multi_academy.subhead: Three workspaces, three brands, three domains. One login. One bill.

brand.title: Brand isolated
brand.description: Own logo, colors, theme. Customers never see partner content.

domain.title: Own domain
domain.description: Point a CNAME, click verify. SSL handled.

invoice.title: One invoice
invoice.description: Add a new academy when you launch a new audience.

automation.heading: API, Webhooks, MCP.
automation.subhead: No middleware in between. Wire it into the stack you already have.

api.title: REST API
api.description: Every object, reachable over HTTP. Provision users, pull completions, build your own tools.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Signed events on enrollment, completion, certificate. Retries on failure.

mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.description: Course authoring as agent tools. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode.
